finding_at_baseline.note: The state found before this change, kept as the record the reports quote. `measured` below is the live count and is re-checked on every run; the two differ by the modules this change itself adds.
finding_at_baseline.deviation_from_the_static_survey: The 2026-09-14 survey at commit 9bb5ab1 reported 418 / 189 / 218-in-any-lane. Four of the five differences are method, one is the tree: (1) three modules run via `python -m unittest`, not pytest — one of them, tests/audit/test_wirelang_spec_freeze_seal_probe.py, in the REQUIRED 'wirelang spec v0.4.3 freeze-seal probe' context, so a pytest-only scan under-reports required coverage by one; (2) tests/live_vm/ is targeted through a bash array (PYTEST_ARGS) that a line scan does not expand; (3) the tree itself gained tests/workflows/test_required_context_error_propagation.py between 9bb5ab1 and this baseline. Direction of the correction: slightly better than reported, and not in a way that changes the conclusion.

measured.method: tooling/ci/lane_inventory.py (static targeting) cross-checked against a real pytest --collect-only run of every lane target
measured.note: Live counts. `tests/lanes/test_lane_assignment.py::test_measured_counts_are_current` re-derives these from the workflows on every run, so they cannot go stale in a report.

required_contexts_source: GET /repos/wakir-labs/wakir-runtime/branches/main/protection, read 2026-09-14. Branch protection is not readable from a workflow without a token, so the list is pinned here; test_lane_assignment.py asserts every entry still matches a job display-name in .github/workflows/.

zero_collect_allowed.tests/wat/external_verifier/test_propert: Property suite behind pytest.importorskip('hypothesis'); hypothesis is not a declared dependency and is installed by no lane. Collects zero outside a hypothesis-bearing environment. Owner: tomas.
zero_collect_allowed.tests/wat/external_verifier/test_python_: Drift canary behind pytest.importorskip('bitcoin'); python-bitcoinlib is matrix-only (external-verifier-drift.yml installs one pinned version per matrix job). Collects zero everywhere else — by design. Owner: tomas.

zero_collect_allowed_note: Allow-list for the zero-collection half of the collect gate: a module that a lane targets but that yields no node IDs. Entries are tolerated when the file is absent (unlike `modules`), so a deletion in another PR does not turn this gate red.

import_guard_allowed.hypothesis: Property-testing library; not a declared dependency and installed by no lane. The one guarded module is external-verifier-only.
import_guard_allowed.bitcoin: python-bitcoinlib, matrix-only: external-verifier-drift.yml installs one pinned version per matrix job and no other lane has it.
import_guard_allowed.wakir_verify: Sibling repository (wakir-labs/wakir-verify), installed from a pinned commit only in the proof-path lane.

import_guard_allowed_note: Names a module-level pytest.importorskip() may legitimately fail on in the production profile. Everything else must be importable there: in a lane whose contract is 'the full install set is present', an import guard that actually skips means a module disappeared without a red check.

phase-3c-opt-in.reason: Phase-3c cutover acceptance + rollback drills. Skip-by-default by construction: every module carries phase_3c_acceptance / phase_3c_doppel_welle_acceptance / phase_3c_rollback_drill and only runs under WAKIR_PHASE_3C_* or the matching --phase-3c-* / --rollback-drill flag (conftest.py). Deliberate: these assert against a dual-run substrate that does not exist in a hermetic runner. 19 modules, 207 tests, all skipped in a default run.

phase-3-skeleton-opt-in.reason: Phase-3 acceptance-gate skeleton behind the phase_3_skeleton marker (opt-in via WAKIR_PHASE_3_SKELETON=1). Deliberate placeholder suite, not a contract in force.

live-vm-operator.reason: TV-LVD live-VM acceptance. Reachable only through workflow_dispatch in live-vm-acceptance.yml and additionally gated by --run-live-vm plus the live_vm marker. Deliberate: needs a real Proxmox VM, cannot run on a GitHub runner.

sbom-baseline-operator.reason: SBOM baseline refresh is an operator-hand action (sbom-baseline-refresh.yml, workflow_dispatch only) because it rewrites a committed baseline. Deliberate: running it automatically would let the baseline chase the artefact instead of pinning it.

wat-core.reason: The WAT/OTS suite — Merkle aggregator, manifest signing, anchor bridge, OTS verify, hash consistency. 46 modules run in no workflow at all; exactly one WAT module (test_anchor_backend.py) is in a required lane and one more directory (external_verifier/) in an optional one. Measured at this baseline: `pytest tests/wat` = 591 passed, 34 skipped, 16s, no podman, no network, no cargo. There is no technical reason these do not run. Named invariants currently unchecked by any gate: Merkle-root construction and proof verification (test_merkle.py, 20 tests), manifest v1/v2 signature + schema admission (test_manifest_signing*.py, test_manifest_v2_*.py), OTS full-verify path (test_ots_full_verify.py), cross-module anchor pin consistency (test_brand_demo_cross_module_anchor_pins.py). This is the proof path Phase 4 is sealing.

proof-path-driver.reason: tests/scripts/test_demo_proof.py — 33 tests against scripts/demo-proof.sh and scripts/demo_proof_helpers.py, including fault injection via DEMO_PROOF_FAIL_STEP and the wakir_verify-absent path. The required `proof-path` context executes that driver end to end but runs none of its tests, so a driver refactor that breaks fault handling is caught only if it also breaks the happy path. Unchecked invariant: the driver reports a non-zero exit and a failed step for every injected fault.

workflow-shape.reason: Hermetic structure tests over .github/workflows/*.yml. Contains the guard that matters most for every other gate in this repo: test_required_context_error_propagation.py asserts that a required context using `needs:` cannot fail open by being skipped (a skipped required check does not block a merge). That guard was added in this very baseline commit and runs nowhere. Unchecked invariant: no required status context can silently disappear when an upstream job fails.

spec-freeze.reason: Hermetic spec-freeze suites for wirelang-spec v0.4.1/v0.4.2/v0.4.3. The required `wirelang spec v0.4.3 freeze-seal probe` context verifies the seal envelope (tests/audit/test_wirelang_spec_freeze_seal_probe.py, via python -m unittest) but not the strict-superset property. Unchecked invariant: v0.4.3 is a strict superset freeze-marker over v0.4.2 with no substance diff (12 tests).

cross-lang-parity.reason: Python/Rust parity suites for persona-engine surfaces (bridge-forward, bridge-audit-writer, federation-resolver, SVID workload identity, federation frame parser, NATS subjects) that live under tests/ rather than wirelang/tests/ and therefore fall outside the one directory the required suite collects. Sibling parity suites inside wirelang/ are required; these are not. Unchecked invariant: the Rust and Python implementations of the same surface agree on the wire. 6 modules, 150 tests, hermetically green.

ci-meta.reason: Hermetic tests about the CI substrate itself. Includes test_branch_protection_check_names_audit.py, which pins required-status-check names against actual job display-names — the exact PR #102 forever-pending failure class — and test_validate_demo_proof_report.py, the report validator the required proof-path context invokes. Unchecked invariant: a workflow edit that renames a protected job display-name is caught hermetically instead of as a stuck pull request.

spec-audit-evidence.reason: Spec/ADR cross-audit and evidence-integrity suites (protocol mirror seed integrity, spec cross-validation, ADR errata cross-audit, v0.4.4 draft coverage). Three sibling modules in the same directory do run — via python -m unittest in the spec probes — which is why this directory looked covered from the workflow text. Unchecked invariant: the protocol mirror seeds and the ADR errata table stay consistent with the spec.

orchestrator-substrate.reason: Hermetic shape tests for compose files, Quadlet units, NATS KV provisioning and the Proxmox bring-up scripts. Despite the podman/NATS subject matter these are static-file and mocked-subprocess tests: `pytest tests/orchestrator` = 361 passed, 9 skipped, 2s, no daemon required. Contains the hermetic counterparts of two required contexts — cosign digest pins (test_compose_spire_cosign_pin.py, test_verify_image_digest*.py) — whose gates today run shell-only.

infra-substrate.reason: Bootstrap, Quadlet, cosign-policy and acceptance-gate consistency tests. Sibling modules in the same directory are required (license hygiene, cross-substrate parity, phase-2 acceptance gates); these 29 are not, with no visible rule separating them. Mostly hermetic (mocked subprocess); the pilot-bootstrap modules shell out but skip cleanly when podman is absent.

observability-routing.reason: Alert-routing, mira-notify emitter/receiver/DLQ and aggregator suites. Seven sibling modules in the same directory each have their own daily workflow; these 20 have none. Unchecked invariant: an alert rule that stops routing to its receiver — the Receiver-Catalog completeness class — is not caught by any gate.

spire-federation-substrate.reason: infra/spire/federation/tests/ — a third test root that is neither `tests/` nor `wirelang/` and is therefore invisible to both testpaths and every lane. 14 modules, 196 tests, hermetically green in 5s. Covers the federation bundle rotator, health endpoint status codes and the Prometheus metrics surface.

script-driver.reason: Hermetic tests for operational scripts (backend/routing decision observability, soak probes, the phase-3b live-VM driver, the legacy env-flag migration detector). The scripts are operator-hand; their tests are not, and run nowhere.

integration-regression.reason: tests/integration/test_bug_42_regression_suite.py — a named regression suite for a fixed bug, sitting next to the one integration module the required production lane does run. A regression suite that never runs cannot regress.
